subpixel-shift.label: Sub-pixel shift nav bar
subpixel-shift.description: Shifts the left navigation bar down by half a pixel

replace-icon.label: Replace external link icon
replace-icon.description: Replaces the external link icon with an alternative icon

remove-banner.label: Remove citations banner
remove-banner.description: Removes the "additional citations" banner causing a massive vertical displacement

expand-qa-paragraph.label: Expand QA paragraph text
expand-qa-paragraph.value: Frequently, functional testing is a quality assurance (QA) process.[4] In practice, it forms an integral part of the software development lifecycle, helping teams verify that newly introduced functionality aligns with defined requirements and the intended user experience. It is often carried out alongside other testing disciplines such as performance testing and security testing to provide comprehensive coverage.
expand-qa-paragraph.description: Expands the QA paragraph with additional text causing a massive vertical displacement

move-footer.label: Shift article footer right
move-footer.description: Moves the article footer 10 pixels to the right

rename-login.label: Rename login link
rename-login.description: Changes the "Log in" link text to "Login" causing horizontal displacement

shift-globe.label: Shift globe onto wordmark (narrow screens)
shift-globe.description: On phone and tablet-width screens, moves the globe logo 30 pixels to the right so it overlaps the Wikipedia text logo next to it

cut-search.label: Cut search button (narrow screens)
cut-search.description: Below 900px width, the search button is increasingly hidden behind a white overlay as the screen narrows

white-search-button.label: Make search button white
white-search-button.description: Changes the portal page search button background and border to white

remove-app-store-badge.label: Remove App Store badge
remove-app-store-badge.description: Removes the "Download on the App Store" app badge

shuffle-languages.label: Shuffle language positions
shuffle-languages.description: Randomly shuffles which language appears in each fixed position slot around the globe, on every page load

remove-sanity-section.label: Remove Sanity testing section
remove-sanity-section.description: Removes the entire "Sanity testing" section, header and body, from the Functional testing article

header-typo.label: Typo in Regression testing header
header-typo.description: Misspells the "Regression testing" section header as "Regresion testing"

random-article-count.label: Random article count
random-article-count.description: Randomly bumps the English and Deutsch article counts by up to 800,000, keeping each locale's number format
